zones.title: Refer received
zones.body: ReferTransferTarget is the Refer-To Twilio received. The UUI hex is decoded, the session gets refer_received, the event carries the target byte-exact.

zones.title: Dial the human
zones.body: With humanNumber in the config the caller is bridged to the phone; without it the line says whether the context was decoded and ends.

panels.title: AR-53 Twilio refer received
panels.body: The proof's pass condition lives here: ReferTransferTarget carries the UUI query parameter, n8n decodes it, the human phone rings. No Twilio signature check on the lab (PoC exception).
